title: Knowledge Base Entry
description: Schema for a single entry in the global curriculum knowledge base — tracking terminology, symbol mapping, evidence, and revision history.

knowledge_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this knowledge entry, e.g. KB-042.

term.description: Canonical term (usually the teaching alias or a neutral name).

source_symbol.description: The actual symbol name in the TypeScript source code, e.g. QueryEngine.query.

teaching_alias.description: Simplified name used for teaching, e.g. '查询引擎'. Must be consistent across all units.

responsibility.description: One-sentence description of what this component/function/concept is responsible for.

status.description: Confirmation status of this knowledge entry.

source_unit.description: The unit ID where this knowledge was first introduced and confirmed.

evidence_status.description: Level of evidence backing this entry.

depends_on.description: List of knowledge_ids that this entry depends on.

supersedes.description: List of knowledge_ids that this entry supersedes.

location.description: File path and optional line range.

used_in_units.description: All unit IDs that reference or depend on this knowledge.

affected_units.description: Units that needed updating due to this revision.

triggered_by.description: What triggered this revision (review finding, user feedback, etc.).
